items.label: T1
items.content: Communicator

items.label: T2
items.content:
This utility allows you to:

-- create a message to send out to the entire MVSC contact list,

-- add an optional multiple choice question to that communication,

-- review the responses you receive to that question.

-- use list management tools to add, edit, delete or audit email records for validity.

items.label: T1
items.content: Audit Emails

items.label: T2
items.content:
This utility checks the entire contact list for valid email addresses.
If it finds a record with more than one valid email or with none, it will give you a chance to edit it so that it will work properly with the Communicator.
You will have the opportunity to edit, delete or pass each record that fails the audit test.

items.label: T3
items.content: Note: Some good emails may be marked as questionable, particularly ones from unusual domains.  Do NOT assume that a flagged record is bad until you check it manually.
